Who Is Jesus?

1- He was a Jew. John 4 verse 9, Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? For the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

2- He was born in Judea. Mathew 2 verse 1, ¶ Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

3- He was from Judah’s tribe. Mathew 1 verse 1, The book of the generation of Jesus [the] Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham. Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas (Judah) and his brethren;

4- He was the Jewish Messiah. Mark 8 verse 29, And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ. Mathew 16 verse 20, Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

5- He was born during Tabernacles. John 1 verse 14, And the Word became flesh, and tabernacled among us (and we beheld his glory, glory as of the only begotten from the Father), full of grace and truth. • There is much evidence that Messiah was born at Tabernacles (Boothes/ Sukkot) on September 11th in 3 B.C. The key to calculating the date of the birth of Messiah is Luke 1 verse 5 where we learn that Zechariah the father of Yochanan was a priest of the course of Abijah. • Jesus was born in a “stable”. The Hebrew word for "stable" is "sukkah" (as in Gen. 33 verse 17) • If Jesus was born on the first day of Tabernacles then he would have been circumcised on the "eigth great day" the festival following Tabernacles. • This would mean that Jesus, the light of the world was conceived by the Spirit during the festival of lights, AKA Hanukkah. Genesis 1 verse 3, 1 verse 14, • This means also that John, His Jewish cousin was born 6 months earlier at Passover which is when Jesus died as our Passover Lamb of God (Mathew 3 verse 1,In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea, Mathew 26 verse 2 Ye know that after two days is the feast of the Passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.)

6- His name is Yeshua (ישוע). Mathew 1 verse 21, And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS verse for he shall save his people from their sins. Mathew 1 verse 25, And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son verse and he called his name JESUS. Other little known facts for consideration 1. Yeshua means “salvation” in Hebrew. In Mathew 1 you see it capitalized in the KJV for a similar reason as YHVH is all caps as LORD when translated. Mathew 1 verse 21 in English makes zero sense when you use the name “Jesus”. 2. Jesus’ ministry according to the Bible was 70 weeks, not 3 ½ years. Many scholars changed their belief to 2 years based on Biblical evidence. But even 2 years is too long when you line up the chronological gospels, from Tishri One in A.D.27 to Tishri One in A.D.28 Sabbatical year. Jesus was 30 years old (30 years after September 11th in 3 B.C) when He started His 70-week ministry.

7- His brother was Jacob. James 1 verse 1, James [Iakobos], a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus [the] Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting. Jesus actually had several siblings recorded in the Bible. “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother’s name Mary, and aren’t his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas? Aren’t all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?” (Matthew 13 verse 55–56)

8- He appeared 12 times Before His ascension, Jesus appeared 12 times in His glorified body. • Mary Magdalene (Mark 16 verse 9–11) • The women at the tomb (Matthew 28 verses 8–10) • Peter (Luke 24 verse 34) • The travelers on the road (Mark 16 verse 12–13) • The disciples without Thomas (Mark 16 verse 14) • The disciples including Thomas (John 20 verse 26–31) • The disciples while they fished (John 21 verse 1–14) • The disciples on the mountain (Matthew 28 verse 16–20) • The crowd of 500 (1 Corinthians 15 verse 6) • James (1 Corinthians 15 verse 7) • Those who were at His ascension (Acts 1 verse 6–9) • Paul (Acts 9 verse 1–6)

9- He appeared before He was born in the flesh John 1 verse 3, All things were made by him; and without him was not anything made that was made. John 6 verse 46, Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father. Colossians 1 verse 16, For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers verse all things were created by him, and for him

10- He was a Rabbi John 3 verse 2, The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God verse for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

Things to ponder that He said. 1 Mathew 4 verse 19, And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men. 2 Mathew 5 verse 17, Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets verse I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil. For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled. Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven, but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven. 3 Mathew 6 verse 33, But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you. 4 Mathew 7 verse 21, Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you verse depart from me, ye that work iniquity. 5 Mathew 10 verse 6, But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. Mathew 15 verse 24, But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel. Mathew 18 verse 11, For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost. 6 Mathew 12 verse 50, For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother. 7 Mathew 13 verse 30, Let both grow together until the harvest verse and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them verse but gather the wheat into my barn. 8 Mathew 16 verse 27, For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works. 9 Mathew 19 verse 28, And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. 10 Mathew 23 verse 39, For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, “Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the LORD”. Baruch haba b'shem Adonai 11 Mathew 24 verse 14, And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come. 12 Mathew 24 verse 24, For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

1 The house of Israel (and the house of Judah). Jesus said he only came for the lost sheep of the “house of Israel”. Jeremiah 31 verse 31 prophesied that the new covenant would be between the house of Judah and the house of Israel. This is confirmed by the writer of Hebrews 8 verse 8. When Jesus was before Pilate, the Jews shouted, “give us the Son of the Father. His blood be on us, and on our children”. Barabbas means son of the father. After He rose, the FIRST thing His disciples asked Him was this verse, Acts 1 verse 6, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel? And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power. You cannot “restore again” something that was not once whole. After King Solomon, the house of Jacob was split into 2 kingdoms; Israel and Judah. 1Samual 17 verse 52, And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines… 1Samual 18 verse 16, But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them. 1Samual 2 verse 10, Ishbosheth, Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David. 2Samual 19 verse 40, ¶ Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him, and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel. 2Samual 19 verse 43, And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye verse why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel. 2Kings 17 verse 18, Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight verse there was none left but the tribe of Judah only. Hebrews 8 verse 8, For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

2 Three days and three nights. Jesus said he would only give us the sign of Jonah verse Mathew 12 verse 40, For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth. And so we see when that happened. Mathew 28 verse 1, In the end of the Sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulcher. But guess what? Jesus had ALREADY risen before the first day of the week on Sabbath’s twighlight!

3 Prophecy. Jesus said He came for the lost sheep of the house of Israel, and sent His disciples to the lost sheep of the house of Israel. He said he did not come to those who were whole, those who were righteous, but to those who were sick. After He said those words to the Pharisees, He said this verse, Mathew 9 verse 13, But go ye and learn what that meaneth, “I will have mercy, and not sacrifice”, for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners (breakers of the law) to repentance. What Scripture was He telling them to go study? Hosea 6 verse 6, For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings. Ezekiel 37 verse 15, The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying, Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions. then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions. And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand. Prophecy continued. Jesus was the “promised Prophet” like unto Moses. Acts 3 verse 22, For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you. Deuteronomy 18 verse 15, ¶ The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken; And there’s more connection between Jesus and Moses. Remember when Moses was on the mountain and God’s people that agreed to obey Him committed adultery/ idolatry? What dod Moses make the people do? Exodus 32 verse 20, And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it. Where did Moses get this idea from?! The cup of adultery Numbers 5 verse 11, And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him, And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner; And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled, or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled… … Numbers 5 verse 17, And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water. When is the next time we see this cup of adultery in the Bible? Mathew 20 verse 22, But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able. Mathew 26 verse 39, And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me, nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt. Mathew 26 verse 42, He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done. Jesus drank His bride’s cup of adultery on her behalf! YES, He “died for our sins”, but that is such a weak and incomplete explanation! He bore the sins of the world (John 1 verse 29), but his “bride” was the house of Israel that He drank the cup of adultery on behalf of. And because of it, everyone received the benefit of having the opportunity to be grafted in to either of the olive trees; Romans 11 verse 24, For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree? Ephesians 2 verse 11, Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands; That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world verse But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ. The blood of Jesus the Messiah brings all gentiles near to the “commonwealth of Israel” so that through faith that leads to good works, we can be grafted into the “wild olive tree” known as “the house of Israel” which is prophesied to become one again. Romans 11 verse 11, I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid, but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy. Paul is not talking about Jews here, he is talking about the house of Israel that was “cut off”. Romans 11 verse 21, For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee. Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God, on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness verse otherwise thou also shalt be cut off. And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again. You can’t be grafted in “again” unless you have been cut off. The gentiles were never cut off. But because the house of Israel was, the gentiles have the opportunity by the blood of Jesus to become sojourners, grafted in to the renewed covenant with the “house of Israel and house of Judah”. Hebrews 8 verse 8, Jeremiah 31 verse 31, So great, so brilliant was the work and deeds of Jesus the Messiah! Planned before the foundation of the world! And the objective for us ALL is that we are to grow to be JUST like Him and ALL be unified in our faith! Ephesians 4 verse 11+ And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ verse 13 says, Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ verse That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine by the sleight of men and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive, verse 15 says, But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ - Jesus basically said, “Im not putting these restriction on you, I’m putting them on myself. But in the same breath, I’m asking you to do what I do."
